import numpy as np
A=np.array(grid)
B=A.copy()
for r in range(A.shape[0]):
    cs=np.where(A[r]==0)[0]
    if len(cs)>=2: B[r,cs.min()+1:cs.max()]=3
for c in range(A.shape[1]):
    rs=np.where(A[:,c]==0)[0]
    if len(rs)>=2: B[rs.min()+1:rs.max(),c]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in B.tolist()))
print('filled',np.sum(B==3))
